info.title: VayuVata API
info.description:
Air-quality monitoring backend. Roles: SuperAdmin, Admin, User (standalone User = User with no Admin).

**User/Admin APIs** use a JWT: call `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.

**ESP32 ingestion** (`POST /api/v1/sensor-data`) does NOT use a JWT. Send the per-device key in the
`X-Device-Key` header. The key is returned once by `POST /api/v1/devices` and can be replaced with
`POST /api/v1/devices/{id}/rotate-key`.

get.summary: List the regular Users managed by the given Admin (paged).
get.description: An Admin may only request their own id (otherwise 403 and no data). Regular Users get 403.

403.description: Caller is a regular User, or an Admin asking for another Admin.

post.summary: Create a User directly under the given Admin (same creation logic as POST /users).
post.description: SuperAdmin: any active Admin. Admin: only when `adminId` is their own id. Role is always `User`.

403.description: Caller is a regular User, or an Admin using another Admin's id.

400.description: Validation failed, or the Admin is inactive.

post.summary: Log in and receive a JWT access token plus a refresh token.
Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access token (refresh token rotates).
Revoke a refresh token. The short-lived access token simply expires.
Register a device. The response contains its API key — shown only once.

get.summary: List devices visible to the caller (paged).

parameters.name: Assigned
parameters.description: true = only assigned devices, false = only unassigned.

get.summary: Get one device by database id.

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate a device (SuperAdmin). Inactive devices cannot ingest or be assigned.

post.summary: Issue a new device API key; the old key stops working immediately (SuperAdmin).
Assign or reassign a device to a User. History is preserved.

get.summary: Assignment history of a device, newest first.
Liveness plus SQL Server connectivity. Returns 503 when the database is unreachable.

post.summary:
ESP32 ingestion. Authenticate with the per-device key in the `X-Device-Key` header (NOT a JWT).
The key is issued when the device is registered / rotated.

429.description: Too many requests from this IP.

get.summary: Readings the caller may see, with device/time filters, sorting and paging.
One reading (404 when its device is outside the caller's scope).

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token.

get.summary: Latest reading of a device (by database id).

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token.

get.summary: Paged reading history of a device with optional from/to (UTC).

401.description: Missing, invalid or expired access token.

get.summary: List the standalone Users: regular Users whose manager is the authenticated SuperAdmin (paged, optional search).
get.description: Never includes Users managed by an Admin. `managerRole` is "SuperAdmin" and `assignmentType` is "Standalone", derived from the stored relationship.

post.description:
* **SuperAdmin → Admin:** `role: "Admin"` (ManagerId = NULL).
* **SuperAdmin → standalone User:** `role: "User"`, no `managerId` → ManagerId is set to the SuperAdmin's own id.
* **SuperAdmin → User under an Admin:** `role: "User"`, `managerId` = an active Admin's id.
* **Admin → User:** `role: "User"`; the manager is always the authenticated Admin (a different `managerId` is rejected with 403).
* Admins cannot create Admins; nobody can create a SuperAdmin through the API.

403.description: Caller may not create this kind of account.

400.description: Validation failed, or `managerId` is not an active Admin / the SuperAdmin.

get.summary: List accounts in the caller's scope (paged).
get.description:
SuperAdmin: all accounts; filters `role`, `managerId`, `standalone`, `isActive`, `search`.
Admin: only Users with ManagerId = their own id; `managerId` (other than their own) and `standalone` are rejected with 403.

parameters.name: Search
parameters.description: Case-insensitive match on name or email.

parameters.name: ManagerId
parameters.description: SuperAdmin only: only accounts managed by this id. An Admin may only pass their own id.

parameters.name: Standalone
parameters.description: SuperAdmin only: true = standalone Users (managed by a SuperAdmin), false = Admin-managed Users.

get.summary: Get one user (404 when outside the caller's scope).

put.summary: Update name and email. Role and manager cannot be changed here.

patch.summary: Activate or deactivate a user. The last active SuperAdmin is protected (409).
SuperAdmin only: change a regular User's manager.
patch.description:
`managerId` is required. Send an **active Admin's id** to assign the User to that Admin, or the **SuperAdmin's own id** to make the
User standalone. `null` does not mean standalone and is rejected. Admin and SuperAdmin accounts cannot be assigned.
The User's devices, device assignments and sensor history are preserved; only visibility follows the new manager.

200.description: Updated user including the manager relationship (`managerId`, `managerRole`, `assignmentType`).

400.description: Target is not a regular User, or `managerId` is missing / not an active Admin / not the SuperAdmin.

get.summary: Devices currently assigned to the user.

post.summary: Set a new password for a user in the caller's scope; revokes their refresh tokens.

AdminUsersPage.description: Page of Users managed by one Admin (GET /admins/{adminId}/users).

ApiError.description: Consistent error body returned by every failing endpoint.

deviceId.description: Physical ESP32 identifier (letters, digits, dash, underscore, colon).

CreateManagedUserRequest.description: Body for POST /admins/{adminId}/users. Role is always User and the manager is the Admin in the route.

deviceId.description: Physical device identifier (must match the owner of the X-Device-Key).

recordedAt.description: UTC time of measurement (ISO-8601). Defaults to server time if omitted. (DeviceId, RecordedAt) uniquely identifies a reading; resubmitting it returns 409.

CreateSensorDataRequest.description: ESP32 reading. All measurements are optional: an omitted/null value is stored as NULL, never 0.

role.description: "Admin" or "User". Only a SuperAdmin may create an Admin. SuperAdmin accounts can never be created through the API.

managerId.description:
SuperAdmin creating a User: id of an active Admin, or omit it to create a standalone User (the backend then sets
ManagerId to the SuperAdmin's own id). Admin creating a User: omit (or send their own id); the manager is always the
authenticated Admin. Not allowed for Admin accounts.

CreateUserRequest.description: Create an account. ManagerId semantics: a regular User is managed by an Admin (`ManagerId` = that Admin) or directly by the SuperAdmin (a "standalone" User, `ManagerId` = the SuperAdmin's id). SuperAdmin and Admin accounts have no manager.

DeviceWithKeyDto.description: Returned once on registration / key rotation. The raw key cannot be retrieved later.

ManagerAssignmentRequest.description:
Change a regular User's manager (SuperAdmin only). `managerId` is required and never means "standalone by omission":
send an active Admin's id to assign the User to that Admin, or the SuperAdmin's own id to make the User standalone.

managerId.description: NULL for SuperAdmin and Admin; otherwise the managing Admin or SuperAdmin.

assignmentType.description: "Standalone" (managed by the SuperAdmin), "AdminManaged", or null for Admin/SuperAdmin accounts.

DeviceKey.description: ESP32 per-device API key (issued once by POST /devices or /devices/{id}/rotate-key). Used ONLY by POST /sensor-data; never a JWT.
DeviceKey.name: X-Device-Key
